summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants for gross proceeds of ~$16.6 million at $6.31 per share, closed June 4, 2026 under an existing shelf registration. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity triggers any special-situation category. The role is issuer raising equity via a shelf takedown.
